lv1.description: Items that just need to be thrown away, and disposing of them takes almost no effort.

lv2.description: Items that satisfy at least one of the following: (a) a storage location for this item is visible in the image, (b) no storage location is visible, but this category of item is highly likely to have a dedicated storage location in a typical home, (c) it only needs to be thrown away, but disposing of it requires extra effort.

lv3.description: Items with no storage location visible in the image, and for which a dedicated storage location cannot be confidently predicted to exist — the storage destination is undetermined, though the item is clearly not trash.

lv4.description: Items that cannot be processed without examining their content to judge whether they are needed or not.
